route_filename_evidence.public_cybersecurity_vulnerability_incid: Campaign166 already governs cybersecurity incident, breach and outage disclosure; Campaign198 separately governs supported-version patch eligibility, deployment and exposure state.
route_filename_evidence.public_clinical_trial_site_enrollment_co: Campaign190 is the exact protocol, site, enrollment, retention, milestone, safety and result evidence frontier and defers it for lack of a complete point-in-time source contract.
route_filename_evidence.public_adverse_event_inspection_enforcem: Campaign166/184 govern incidents, recalls and remediation; Campaign190 governs clinical safety; Campaign219 governs pharmaceutical batch quality and CAPA; Campaign221 governs inspection, nonconformity and certification lifecycle.
route_filename_evidence.public_utility_connection_outage_restora: Campaign204 is the exact utility application, connection, meter, interruption, outage membership, restoration, disconnection and reconnection frontier and defers it for lack of an admitted privacy-safe complete source.
route_filename_evidence.public_public_private_partnership_conces: Campaign179 governs public-service infrastructure concessions and service territories; Campaign200 governs mobilization, performance certification, deductions, handover and completion.
route_filename_evidence.public_standard_committee_association_pa: Campaign221 governs standards, methods, accreditation and certificate lifecycle, but no prior complete issuer-to-committee participation history or admitted source contract exists for standard-setting influence.
route_filename_evidence.public_physical_store_poi_open_close_ope: Campaign229 governs franchise site approval, buildout, opening, reopening, transfer and closure; Campaign213 governs store execution and omnichannel operations. A POI provider or locator snapshot is not an independent point-in-time store lifecycle.

route_results.reason: Campaign166 already freezes cybersecurity breach, privacy exposure, ransomware and service-outage incident disclosure, while Campaign198 freezes vulnerability, patch eligibility, release, deployment, compliance and exposure state. Selecting a CVE source, severity, affected product, patch stage or remediation window is a prohibited source, field, cohort or window rescue.

Campaign190 confirms this is an economically distinct issuer state, but no admitted 2019-2023 point-in-time history freezes sponsor and issuer mapping, protocol amendments, sites, enrollment denominator, suspension, completion, result corrections and first-public timing. A latest registry snapshot cannot satisfy the frozen source gate.

Incident, recall, safety, inspection, nonconformity, CAPA, clinical adverse-event and certificate states are already partitioned across Campaign166, Campaign184, Campaign190, Campaign219 and Campaign221. Choosing one regulator, product class, warning type or remediation stage would relabel an existing terminal mechanism.

Campaign204 confirms a distinct utility service-continuity state, but no admitted privacy-safe point-in-time source preserves issuer, service point, meter, network-zone, interruption membership, restoration, unresolved, disconnection and reconnection histories with the complete applicable denominator. Public outage dashboards or current maps cannot be projected backward.

Campaign179 already freezes public-service infrastructure concession, franchise and territory rights, while Campaign200 freezes project mobilization, certification, variation, deduction, handover and completion. PPP labels, government counterparties, availability payments or handback stages do not create a new economic mechanism.

Standard-setting influence is distinct from testing or certificate issuance, but the repository has no admitted complete point-in-time history linking listed issuers and material subsidiaries to committee membership, role, draft, vote, revision, withdrawal and first-public availability across the full applicable population. A current membership list or document-author snapshot is insufficient.

Campaign229 already freezes site approval, buildout, opening, reopening, transfer and closure, and Campaign213 freezes store execution and order/return operations. Replacing the lifecycle source with a POI vendor, store locator or geocoding snapshot is a provider and snapshot rescue with unresolved historical disappearance and denominator bias.

decision.reason: Four routes duplicate immutable terminal mechanisms and three are economically distinct but lack a complete lawful point-in-time source contract. The frozen priority rule therefore stops Campaign277 before formula, direction, source fields, rows or values.
decision.next_safe_work: Campaign278 may freeze a new finite concept-only catalog before targeted inventory. It must not rescue a deferred Campaign277 route with a current snapshot, incomplete coverage, sibling source, entity role, jurisdiction, field, metric, window, threshold or direction.
